title: The search after the search
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 aspect (1080x1350), designed for Instagram feed carousels (full frame visible) and TikTok photo carousels. SAFE ZONES: (a) Instagram profile grid crops to CENTER 1:1 — the top ~135px and bottom ~135px are cropped in the grid view, so keep the hero subject center-frame. (b) TikTok photo mode overlays a caption/UI region across the bottom ~340px on the visible feed — keep any critical visual detail above that band. (c) The lower ~40% of the frame (roughly y=810 to y=1350 on a 1080x1350 canvas) is reserved for on-slide type — subject sits in the upper ~55-60% with a naturally darker, less busy lower area. No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B. All six slides are pure photos. No device composite. Companion to scene-13 — where scene-13 states the 65% stat, this one walks through the mechanic that produces it.

slides.imagePrompt: A traveler seated in a warm cafe or hotel lounge, holding a phone with a completely blank pure-white screen, a plant nearby, natural window light. Face soft, not the focus. No visible UI on the phone. The subject or device must sit in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame, leaving a clean, uncluttered, darker LOWER ~40% for text. CRITICAL: any darker area must be darker ONLY because the scene's own light falls off naturally — NOT because a dark band, gradient, vignette or overlay has been applied. There must be NO horizontal boundary, step, line or abrupt change of tone anywhere in the frame; brightness must fall away gradually and continuously. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.body: The guest types 'boutique hotel Vancouver' into Booking. They see twenty properties. Yours is one of them. So far, so ordinary.

slides.body: One of the photos catches their eye. Or the location. Or the room description. They tap in, read reviews, look at rates. Twenty seconds of real attention.
